title: Natural support tensor projection formulas on unbounded condensed modules
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring, X,Z,U schemes, i:Z→X a closed immersion and j:U→X a quasi-compact open immersion with complementary images. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories of pulled-back Λ-module objects, the exact termwise image i*, open extension j!, and supportPullback. The two canonical unit/counit-induced maps of [def-sfb-open-closed-internal-hom-comparisons] are isomorphisms: j!(L ⊗ᴸ j^*T)→j!L ⊗ᴸ T and i*P ⊗ᴸ T→i*(P ⊗ᴸ i^*T), for every L,P,T. In particular there are no boundedness, constructibility or finiteness restrictions on L,P,T, and no global qcqs hypothesis on X.

proof.text: Use derived open/closed localization: open unit and closed counit invertible, supported closed unit invertible, mixed restrictions zero and joint detection of isomorphisms.

Pullback commutes with derived tensor via the already normalized supportDerivedTensorComparison. Thus open restriction of i_*P tensor T vanishes, making its closed unit invertible. Its composite with pullback tensor comparison and the tensor of the closed counit is the canonical closed projection, hence invertible. For the open projection the closed restriction has zero source and target. The open restriction becomes invertible after composing with the invertible open unit: by the homEquiv_unit identity this is precisely tensor of the unit followed by inverse pullback tensor comparison. Joint detection proves the open projection invertible. No independent K-flat descent is required.

lean.statement:
theorem openClosedSupportProjectionFormula {Z U X : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : U ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (hij : Set.range i.base = (Set.range j.base)ᶜ) :
    let := closedSupport_lowerStarExact Λ i j hij
    (∀ P T, IsIso (closedSupportProjection Λ i P T)) ∧
    (∀ L T, IsIso (openSupportProjection Λ j L T))
